name: ftell
expr: fname = tempname; fid = fopen(fname, 'w'); fwrite(fid, [1 2 3]); fclose(fid); fid = fopen(fname, 'r'); fread(fid, 1); pos = ftell(fid); fclose(fid); delete(fname); r1 = double(pos > 0);
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip via tempname). ftell after one read -- positive position.
